digest.component_or_area: tickets store crash-atomicity and sync recovery
propositions: Parallel compaction mutations to the worktree (snapshot writes, file renames, deletions) occur before git commit with no rollback on worker death, leaving dirty tree that breaks merge and strands local commits.

Untracked file collisions and tracked file deletions/modifications during union merge cause sync to abort; tracked runtime markers (*/.archived, */.write.lock) committed before gitignore patterns were added are never un-tracked and produce perpetual dirty state.

Compaction fold must become crash-atomic: writes intent journal sentinel outside worktree before mutation, commits as unit with rollback on failure, and recovery preamble reverts abandoned partial folds by journal presence check.

Sync recovery path (_union_merge) and push-recovery path must detect and recover both untracked-collision and tracked-deletion abort variants on store artifacts by restoring or quarantining dirty files.
fsck command detects dirty-tree and stale-lock classes (tracked deletions, untracked regenerable artifacts, orphaned locks); doctor --repair heals these under write lock.
Store-wide scans (fsck, compact-all) default to active-only tickets and accept --include-archived flag to include archived tickets, scaling cost to active working set.
